monkey-mart.title: Monkey Mart Game: Manage Your Supermarket Online for Free
monkey-mart.description: Dive into the world of Monkey Mart, a fun simulation game where you manage your own supermarket as a monkey! Plant fruits, harvest crops, and sell goods. Play Monkey Mart online for free and experience the thrill of managing your own store. Start growing your Monkey Mart empire today!

HomeIframe.title: Monkey Mart
HomeIframe.description: Monkey Mart is a simulation game developed by Tiny Dobbins where you manage a supermarket as a monkey.

HomeFeatures.whatIsDescription: Monkey Mart is a simulation game where players manage a supermarket as a monkey, planting fruits, harvesting crops, and selling goods to customers.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep1: Use WASD or arrow keys to move your monkey.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep2: Stand on empty plots to plant crops, and near mature plants to harvest.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep3: Place harvested food on stands for customers to purchase.
HomeFeatures.feature1Description: Charming characters and scenes appeal to players of all ages in Monkey Mart.
HomeFeatures.feature2Description: Easy to understand gameplay suitable for all players in Monkey Mart.
HomeFeatures.feature3Description: Engage with customers and manage employees in a lively atmosphere in Monkey Mart.
HomeFeatures.feature4Description: Customize your store layout and product selection in Monkey Mart.
